message.content: FY2024 results look solid (revenue +~5%, net margin ~2.9%, ~$11.3B operating cash flow), though the ~53.8x P/E on $16.56 EPS means a modest starter position is more appropriate than a large one under the mandate. I'll buy 5 shares (~$4,456), well inside both the $5,000 per-order and $10,000 daily caps.
message.reasoning:
Costco FY2024: revenue $254.45B, net income $7.367B (~2.9% margin), EPS $16.56, OCF $11.34B. P/E at $891.09 ≈ 53.8x — rich but consistent with Costco's premium multiple. Stock is at all-time highs around $891. Mandate: buy only, ≤$5,000 per order, ≤$10,000 total today, limit close to market. Buying 5 shares = ~$4,455, within $5,000. Limit price close to market: $892.00 or so. Let's do 5 shares at $892.00 (slightly above ask, ~+0.1%, close to market).

Compute: 5 × 892 = $4,460 ≤ $5,000. Total today $4,460 ≤ $10,000. Good.

Place order.
